description: This file is the main entry point for a Vue.js frontend application. It imports CSS styles, creates the Vue app instance, integrates Pinia for state management and Vue Router for navigation, then mounts the app to the DOM element with id 'app'.

methods.name: createApp
methods.description: Creates a new Vue application instance.

methods.name: createPinia
methods.description: Creates an instance for Pinia state management.

methods.name: app.use
methods.description: Registers plugins (Pinia and router) with the Vue app.

methods.name: app.mount
methods.description: Mounts the Vue application to a DOM element.
